text:
Nora - Product: FYI team: we're publishing the "On‑Prem Image Attestation & Remote Support" policy for Private/VPC/on‑prem. Effective 2026-07-15. Goal: tighten how we grant remote support while keeping onboarding smooth. Key points below. :mag:

Diego - Eng-Platform: quick summary pls?

Nora - Product: tl;dr: remote support for on‑prem clusters requires a signed vendor attestation embedded in the image OR an HSM-backed signature exchange at support time. Customers can choose (1) vendor-signed image (recommended) or (2) ephemeral HSM attestation handshake. Telemetry remains opt-in by default; support will only request minimal logs and ask for explicit customer consent to retrieve them.

Rina - Security: adding: attestation format will be COSE signed JSON with claims: image_hash, builder_id, timestamp, support_levels. Example header we discussed:```
{"alg":"ES256","kid":"redwood-prod-bldr-03"}
{"image_hash":"sha256:...","builder":"redwood-builder-v5","issued":"2026-04-15T12:00:00Z","support":"remote-debug:yes,remote-shell:no"}
```
Support handshake for HSM path will use mutual TLS + signed nonce exchange.

Tom - Support: important for Support — will customers who decline attestation be denied remote assistance?

Nora - Product: not denied. Policy allows three tiers:
```
- Tier A: Vendor-signed image + telemetry opt-in -> Full remote support (shell, log pull)
- Tier B: HSM ephemeral attestation + telemetry opt-in -> Limited remote support (log pull w/ consent, guided commands)
- Tier C: No attestation + telemetry OFF -> Remote support by phone/guide only; on-site or customer-run debugging required
```

Priya - Legal: we'll need consent language for the log pull and an addendum template for new contracts. I'll draft consent short-form and a checkbox flow for the portal.

claire.sales: can we surface this in the quote/ordering flow? Sales needs the customer's choice captured at provisioning time.

Diego - Eng-Platform: we can add a provisioning flag `--support-attestation=[vendor|hsm|none]` and set default to `none` unless the customer opts in. I'll open a PR for the CLI and API today.

deploy-bot: feature flag "onprem.attestation_required_v1" created in staging at 2026-04-20T09:12Z.

Nora - Product: action owners + dates:```
- Eng-Platform (Diego) -> API/CLI flag + provisioning field, schema change + PR -> due 2026-05-12
- Security (Rina) -> attestation spec, COSE template, HSM handshake spec -> due 2026-04-30
- Support (Tom) -> runbooks, consent scripts, sample customer script -> due 2026-05-20
- Legal (Priya) -> consent text, contract addendum, support T&Cs -> due 2026-04-28
- Sales (claire.sales) -> ordering flow copy, enablement slides -> due 2026-05-05
- Product (Nora) -> public KB + internal support matrix -> due 2026-04-25
```

Rina - Security: note — export-control and crypto export paperwork may be required for HSM workflows in certain EMEA/APAC countries. I'll flag a list of restricted countries.

Tom - Support: we'll prepare a staged comms plan: (1) internal enablement, (2) targeted outreach for high-touch customers with instructions, (3) template for engineers if customers choose manual on-site assistance.

Nora - Product: communications cadence: internal enablement next week, public KB week after. We'll announce to customers 60 days before enforcement; customers get a 120-day migration window if they need more time.

ops-bot: New dashboard metric `onprem.attestation.adoption_rate` added. Default telemetry for new onprem clusters = OFF.

Diego - Eng-Platform: question — do we allow retrofitting attestation to running clusters?

Rina - Security: yes — we'll support an "attach-attestation" flow that verifies image hash and signs an attestation record. This will be gated behind admin permissions and audited.

Nora - Product: please channel follow-ups into the #private-product-sync thread and tag me if blockers. Thanks everyone — this should reduce blast-radius for remote access while keeping support practical. :white_check_mark:
